art_direction: A — dark classical oil painting, Gothic Victorian Western European town
originals_policy: Copied generated PNG outputs into project unchanged; source images retained.

characters.name: 共情者
characters.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one finished character portrait for the Gothic Victorian European village social deduction game Ravens Night. Derive a NEW PORTRAIT from the supplied A artwork. Input image is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference only, not a character identity reference. Preserve its finely rendered dark classical oil-painting realism, very detailed natural skin, tactile aged wool and brass, restrained copper-gold thin Gothic arch border, blue-black and smoky-grey palette with small amber practical lights. Replace the entire human identity, costume, props and background with the subject specified below. One single adult, natural anatomy, distinctly individual face; the whole head, both hands and important prop visible. Vertical 3:4 composition, approximately head to mid-thigh; head top at 6–12% and eyes at 20–25%, with breathing room inside the arch. The face and hands are clearly readable at phone size, luminous midtones but dark atmospheric edges. Mature, quiet, believable Western European Victorian town; no magical powers, floating symbols, or glow other than actual candle flames. No words, labels, numbers, UI, watermarks, extra people, modern objects, Chinese or other East Asian period costume, anime, engraving, flat geometry, graphic gore. Return just the finished portrait, not a comparison.
Subject: EMPATH, a gentle 38-year-old male village listener and country physician. New identity unlike any reference: rounded oval face, broad soft nose, hazel eyes, short chestnut curls, clean-shaven, attentive slightly concerned expression. His head tilts slightly as though patiently listening. Modest charcoal-brown Victorian frock coat over a moss-grey waistcoat and cream high-collar shirt, a very small plain antique brass clasp brooch at the lapel; no symbols or magic. One natural hand holds a small brass candle holder at waist height with a single modest flame; the other rests gently against the coat near his chest, all fingers anatomically convincing. A quiet surgery sitting room with old dark timber, linen and a narrow arched rain-streaked window giving a glimpse of the blue-black town. Candle light softly reveals warm, humane skin and real cloth. No stethoscope or modern medical equipment, no weapon. Keep the A reference border proportion and rendering, but entirely change the man, gesture and setting.

qa.notes: New gentle adult male identity, full head and both hands visible; natural candle and brooch, detailed wool/brass, blue-black surgery backdrop, matching thin copper-gold arch, no text/UI/magic.
